name: Hairy-banded Andrena
desc: Hairy-banded Andrena (Andrena hirticincta): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 6 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The hairy-belted miner bee is a species of miner bee in the family Andrenidae. Another common name for this species is the hairy-banded andrena.
